classification: Exact source excerpt for Stones of Binding and both Arathi wanted bounties, with matching provider catalog/combat/drop records and reward references. Not a complete archive or observed payout.

directives.text: Kill Drywhisker Kobolds, Drywhisker Diggers and Drywhisker Surveyors. Loot them for their Motes
The quest turn in for this is inside the Cave. Clear your way to the back while completing it
Click the Iridescent Shards at the back of the Cave
Open the Stone of East Binding. Loot it for the Cresting Key
Open the Stone of Outer Binding. Loot it for the Thundering Key
Open the Stone of West Binding. Loot it for the Burning Key
Make sure the Forsaken Courier doesn't sneak past you as you do this!
Open the Stone of West Binding. Loot it for the Burning Key
Click the Stone of Inner Binding
Kill Marez Cowl. Loot her for her Head
Marez Cowl has 2 different spawn locations. One is on the high ground location, and the other is below behind the house. They are marked on your map
Cast [Eagle Eye] to try and find which location she is in
Kill Otto and Lord Falconcrest. Loot them for their Heads
Kill Marez Cowl. Loot her for her Head
Marez Cowl has 2 different spawn locations. One is on the high ground location, and the other is below behind the house. They are marked on your map
Be careful as there are [Stealthed] level 36-37 elite Syndicate Prowlers in the area surrounding both her spawns
Cast [Eagle Eye] to try and find which location she is in
Skip this step if you're not confident in your ability to solo it
Kill Marez Cowl. Loot her for her Head
Marez Cowl has 2 different spawn locations. One is on the high ground location, and the other is below behind the house. They are marked on your map
Be careful as there are [Stealthed] level 36-37 elite Syndicate Prowlers in the area surrounding both her spawns
Cast [Eagle Eye] to try and find which location she is in
Turn in Wanted! Otto and Falconcrest
Turn in Wanted! Otto and Falconcrest
Turn in Wanted! Otto and Falconcrest

objectiveText: Gather 12 Motes of Myzrael, then bring them to the Iridescent Shards in Drywhisker Gorge.
Gather the Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key from the Stone of West Binding, the Stone of East Binding and the Stone of Outer Binding.
Bring them to the Stone of Inner Binding.
Bring Marez's head to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
Bring Otto's Head and Falconcrest's Head to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.

dungeonKillXpReference.source: Owner-supplied planning range: a level-20 dungeon elite killed by five level-20 players gives 24–30 XP per player. Build and sample context are unverified; other levels use a solo-base and level-weighted-share extrapolation. No further division by five, party bonus or patch bonus.
